description: Angular component for configuring marker shape and icon settings in a map widget, including popover interactions and preview generation.

classes.name: MarkerShapeSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for marker shape/icon configuration with popover selection and preview.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form controls and subscriptions for value changes.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers callback for value change propagation.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the component's model value and updates the form and preview.

methods.name: openShapePopup
methods.description: Opens a popover for selecting marker shape or icon, updates form controls based on selection.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change.

methods.name: updatePreview
methods.description: Generates shape or icon preview URL or HTML based on current model.
